panels.title: Heartbeat (Last Signal Age)
panels.description: Time since the last signal was received. Green = active, Red = possibly stale.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -2h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals" and r._field == "signal_strength")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${side}" == "both" then true else r.side == "${side}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: uint(v: date.sub(d: r._time, from: now()))) / 60000000000.0 }))

panels.title: Signals (1h)
panels.description: Total signals received in the last hour

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals" and r._field == "signal_strength")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${signal_type:regex}" == ".*" then true else r.signal_type =~ /${signal_type:regex}/)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)

panels.title: Error Rate (1h)
panels.description: Percentage of signals with error flag in last hour. 0% = healthy.

targets.query:
total = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_health" and r._field == "event_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/)
  |> sum()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "total")

errors = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_health" and r._field == "error_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/)
  |> sum()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "errors")

union(tables: [total, errors])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r.total > 0.0 then r.errors / r.total else 0.0 }))
